decisions.rationale: Project's minimal-dependency constraint excludes typing_extensions (Option 2); bumping requires-python to >=3.11 (Option 1) would narrow the declared floor. TypedDict performs zero runtime enforcement and check() sets 'kind' on all 4 return paths, so the total=False type-checker weakening is purely theoretical.
